label: The categories
subgoals: List timing, power, reliability, physical and functional checks
Name the tool input each check needs
Require every check to be clean at its worst conditions

label: Matching checks to conditions
subgoals: Assign each check to the corner where it is hardest

Re-run those checks on the changed design
Record the input versions each check used
